svg.title: RP-01 HOME-BOK-01 provisional layout reference
svg.desc: Thirty-two by twenty-eight tile house plan with exact scene-map zones, six doorways, seventeen fixture targets, marked interaction approaches, and statically connected routes. Developer authoring reference only, not collision-tested or a player map.
svg.text: PROVISIONAL AUTHORING PLAN — not a player screen; not collision-tested
Origin upper left · inclusive tile coordinates · 32 × 28 tiles · 16 logical pixels per tile
Navy = footprint; hollow moss dot = approach tile.
Dashed green targets are standing spots, not solid props.
Both chair anchors shown; only one chair may exist.
Yellow = doorway; moss routes connect mailbox to targets.
Crops include door context; shift for active window/edge.
All 17 target approaches and 6 doors are statically reachable.
This checks tile connectivity only, not sprite collision/occlusion.
Keep fixture anchors, doorway sides, tile scale and room links consistent across every mockup.
The connected house extends beyond each camera crop. Do not turn this diagram into a player map or room selector.
STATIC CHECK: all approaches reachable • no listed doorway/approach overlaps a solid fixture
Future checks: actual 24×24 source contact, headgear bounds, path width, foreground cutaway, phone legibility.
